title: Seagrove Beach 4BR Vacation Home with a Communal Pool
meta_description: Stay at 3 Mermaids Haven, a 4BR, 3BA 30A vacation home in Seagrove Beach, with a communal pool, Xplorie activities, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 10.
description_expanded: A beautiful cottage south of 30A in Seagrove Beach, is gleaming with modern, yet classic updates all around. You are just across from the public access to Eastern Lake and short bike ride or walk to the beach and includes a large community pool. With this central location you are minutes from every activity imaginable for your 30A vacation.Home Highlights:2-minute Walk to Large Community Pool (100 yards)Dining Accommodations: 10 Table Seating, 2 Bar SeatingDistance to Beach: .5 MilesHigh Speed Wi-Fi3 Mermaids Haven is a 2-story home with open concept living and dining on the 1st floor. Enjoy multiple outdoor spaces to soak up the Florida sunshine. Grab a cup of coffee (drip coffeemaker) in the morning and head outside to listen to the birds and the breeze which includes multiple outside seating options. If you're lucky you can grab some fresh citrus just outside the back door.Cook up an amazing BBQ feast on the charcoal grill. Inside, you will find 2 bedrooms on the 1st floor and 2 additional bedrooms on the 2nd floor along with the laundry. This is a perfect space for 2 families, a large family, or a girls' getaway to stretch out and enjoy some much-needed relaxation.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Bunkroom with 2 twin xl-over-twin xl bunk beds and TV1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed with TVBedrooms 2 and share hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, large TV. Private bathroom with large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, seating area and private balcony. Luxurious private bathroom with rainfall shower and large freestanding tub.30A & Seagrove Beach:Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs the length of 30A -- hop on just around the corner. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach.Beach Access:Take a left from the front door onto Lakewood Drive. Follow Lakewood until Beachfront Trail and turn right. There is a public parking lot here as well. Down the end of Beachfront Trail is your beach access, Walton Dunes.Distance: .5 miles | Time: 9 minutes walkingThe beach access features parking, a bike rack, and effortless entry to the sand – no stairs! The community also features public park access to Eastern Lake for paddle boarding, fishing, or kayaking.Your stay at 3 Mermaids Haven comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars in driveway.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
